user_reported_bug: Loop 4473f240 on 2026-07-27: ChatPanel showed 'Loop failed to start' while LoopStatusChip showed 'LOOP · PLANNING'. Root cause: sync /loop/start blocked past 60s axios timeout. Fix (Iter 312): backend fire-and-forget + planning visible in /loop/active (already fully validated in iteration_318), frontend timeout recovery + SSE bind + plan absorption + approval card render. iteration_319 found TWO specific gaps in the frontend: (a) LoopStatusChip's onPhaseUpdate callback was overwriting loopPhase='plan_pending' back to raw 'plan', which suppressed the PlanApprovalCard's showPlanCard gate; (b) formatPlanMarkdown only knew the legacy plan schema (bullets + files_to_change) and ignored the engine's actual awaiting_confirmation payload (description + steps + files-of-objects). BOTH ARE NOW FIXED. This run must verify closure.
